summary.en: The Rapid Support Forces carried out a drone strike on Nyala, killing at least 21 people and injuring 40 while cutting power in southeast Sudan. In the Blue Nile, the Sudanese Armed Forces repelled a fresh RSF and SPLM-N assault, seizing 15 combat vehicles. Saudi Arabia reported that its air defenses intercepted Houthi missiles over the capital, and the West warned of a famine risk as the war grinds on. The conflict caused 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: RSF-militsen utførte et droneangrep i Nyala, der minst 21 personer ble drept og 40 såret, samtidig som strømmen ble kuttet i sør-øst Sudan. I Blue Nile avviste den sudanske hæren (SAF) et nytt angrep fra RSF og SPLM-N, og tok kontroll over 15 kampkjøretøy. Saudi-Arabia rapporterte at luftforsvaret deres avskjærte houthi-missiler over hovedstaden, og Vesten advarte om risiko for hungersnød ettersom krigen fortsetter. Konflikten forårsaket 4 680 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Sudanese civil war (2023–present)
background.extract: Since April 2023, there has been a civil war in Sudan between the two main factions of the country's military government. The conflict involves the internationally recognized government of Sudan led by the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF), under General Abdel Fattah al-Burhan; against the rival Government of Peace and Unity led by the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) paramilitary group, commanded by General Hemedti. Smaller armed groups have also taken part on both sides, most notably Sudan Liberation Movement splinter groups, the Tamazuj militia, and the Darfur Joint Protection Force.
background.extractNb: Konflikten i Sudan 2023 er en pågående væpnet konflikt mellom rivaliserende fraksjoner i Sudans regjering som brøt ut den 15. april 2023 over hele landet. Konflikten er hovedsakelig i hovedstaden Khartoum og i Darfurregionen.
